rows.04:6f1c:
Their injuries were pretty light compared to the seniors'.
It was all faked, after all.
On top of that, the second- and third-years who were the club's core were too hurt to move, right?
So ironically, it fell to Akasaka and the other first-years to carry the boxing club.{p}
rows.04:8478:
"Hey!
Akasaka... Akasaka is dead☆"
When Hatanaka said that, pretending to go pale, the seniors fell for it, hook, line and sinker.
They started talking over how to hide Akasaka's body.
"How about we bury him?"
"No, they'd find him the second a search started."
"Then what do we do?"
"First we burn him.
We'll reduce him to bones so he's easier to hide."
The seniors were totally convinced it was their own fault.
"Once he's bones, where do we hide him?"
"Let's see, the best hiding place would be... over there, wouldn't it?"{p}
rows.04:92c0:
...{a}, go check out the boxing club sometime.
It's not much of a club these days.
But there's one thing about it that's really something.
Let me tell you what it is.{p}
rows.04:9c90:
Yeah, Hatanaka went to the place where they'd buried the body.
And what does he find but the outline of a person laid out on the dirt in white rope.
"No way...
Did somebody find Akasaka's body here...?"
Hatanaka touched the dirt there with trembling hands.
...There was no sign it had been dug up.
Then what was this rope...?
Behind Hatanaka, he heard something stir.
"Hatanaka.
That rope marks the spot for someone who's about to die.
And that someone is... you.
They're going to find you lying right here."
Akasaka was behind Hatanaka.
Akasaka's ghost was riding piggyback on Hatanaka's back.
So even when Hatanaka turned around, he couldn't see Akasaka.
"Akasaka★
Where are you?
Where the hell are you★"
Hatanaka thrashed around blindly.
Spinning around, swinging his arms, kicking at the air...
But he couldn't see Akasaka anywhere, and only that voice kept ringing right in his ear.
And then...{p}
